meta.anchorRule: tile=i,x,y,w,h,ox,oy: crop rect (x,y,w,h) from img; draw so that pixel (ox,oy) of the crop sits on the CENTER of the map cell diamond. cellCenter = ((col-row)*96, (col+row)*48 + 48). Objects depth-sort by (col+row) then col.
meta.axes: map +x (col+1) = screen down-right; +y (row+1) = screen down-left; -x = up-left; -y = up-right. Orientation strings refer to MAP axes.

orientationConvention.open+x: wall/edge piece whose open side (floor / land / other terrain) is the +x neighbour (face points screen down-right, visible textured face)
orientationConvention.open+y: open side is +y (face points screen down-left, visible)
orientationConvention.open-x: open side is -x (face points up-left; drawn as black back-face silhouette)
orientationConvention.open-y: open side is -y (face points up-right; black back-face)
orientationConvention.diag+x+y: only the diagonal (+1,+1) neighbour is open (concave/inner corner of the wall mass, visible)
orientationConvention.open+x+y: both +x and +y open (convex/outer corner pointing at the camera)
orientationConvention.open-x+y: both -x and +y open (convex corner, screen left)
orientationConvention.open-x-y: both -x and -y open (convex corner, screen top, black)
orientationConvention.open+x-y: both +x and -y open (convex corner, screen right)

blocks.all: collision 1 BLOCKS_ALL (walls, trees, pillars: blocks movement and projectiles)
blocks.movement: collision 2 BLOCKS_MOVEMENT (water, pits, small props: projectiles pass)

meta.layers: background (floor, water, shore), object (walls, props, depth-sorted), bridge (cave planks over pits, drawn above background), snowplains also uses background_fringe/snow_bottom/snow_top overlays. collision layer values: 0 none, 1 all, 2 movement, 3/4 hidden variants of 1/2 (used for off-map void), 5/6 map-only.
meta.usageFields: usage.count = occurrences in empyrean_campaign maps using this tileset; usage.col = most common collision value under the tile; usage.layer = layer where it appears most
meta.biome: grassland: forest, farms, town (Black Oak City, Lochport)

rules.cliffs: Identical 8-neighbour scheme to cave walls: open+x 48/52, open+y 49/53, open-x 50/54 (black), open-y 51/55 (black), diag+x+y 56/60, diag-x+y 57/61, diag-x-y 58/62, diag+x-y 59/63, open+x+y 64/68, open-x+y 65/69, open-x-y 66/70, open+x-y 67/71. Background under cliffs: grass floor (Flare keeps grass under all cliffs, void 0 only outside the map). Collision 1.
rules.water: Water is LOWER than land: shore pieces 144-167 (192x192, background layer, collision 2) wrap full water 176-191. Same 8-neighbour logic with water="solid": edges 144-151, outer corners 152-159, inner corners 160-167. Docks 192-207 go on the background layer over water with collision 0.
rules.trees: Single trunk cell, collision 1, object layer; canopies overlap neighbours so rows of trees read as a wall. Flare maps mix all 4 species.
rules.grassPattern: floor index = 16 + (row%4)*4 + (col%4) reproduces the Flare look; random choice also fine.
